title: Malawi calculator-readiness follow-up evidence
purpose: Deepen the existing Malawi evidence record and identify an actionable route to crop-level yields, farm input expenditures, labour, machinery, and producer sales data. This file does not activate Malawi or alter calculator formulas.

new_findings.source: IHSN Survey Catalog / Malawi National Statistical Office
facts: Nationally representative IHS6 conducted July 2024 to July 2025; final national response rate 99.9%; sampling covers all districts including Likoma.
Agriculture modules cover rainy and dry-season plot/garden rosters and details, Affordable Input Programme, other inputs, crops, seeds, sales/storage, livestock and livestock products.
Survey records land areas, labour and non-labour input use and expenditures, crop production, and supports disaggregation by main geographical regions.

Important reference-period limitation: cross-sectional households report the last completed rainy season (2022/23 or 2023/24) and dry season (2023 or 2024), depending on interview timing. This is not a 2024/25 crop-season yield dataset.
The IHSN catalog directs users to the World Bank Microdata Library for data access. Dataset download and variable-level extraction have not yet been completed.
new_findings.calculator_use: High-priority source for weighted smallholder enterprise-cost and productivity estimation after microdata access, questionnaire/variable review, weighting, crop-season separation and district/region sample-size checks. Do not treat the catalogue metadata itself as extracted numeric budgets.

new_findings.topic: 2025 National Census of Agriculture report and microdata
facts: 2025 NACA provides estimates at national, regional, Agricultural Development Division, district, urban and rural levels.
Household report covers 29,648 smallholder farming households; census collection also covered estates and communities.
Collected themes include land use, agricultural practices, irrigation, agricultural services, farm machinery, labour input, livestock and aquaculture.
NSO page provides report and key-findings downloads and a microdata access route.
new_findings.calculator_use: Priority extraction target for current small-area structure, crop geography, irrigation, machinery and labour indicators. The existence of these topics does not establish that complete crop-by-district enterprise budgets are published in the report.

new_findings.source: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture announcement reported by Yoneco FM
new_findings.calculator_use: Record as government minimum-price policy references for the named season and product specifications only. These are not verified producer transaction averages, regional price observations or net farmgate receipts. Confirm official ministry circular and implementation before use.

new_findings.source: IFPRI Malawi Maize Market Report September 2026
facts: IFPRI reports average maize retail prices rose 3 percent in September 2026.
Retail prices were highest in the Southern Region and lowest in the Northern Region.
Retail maize prices remained below the minimum farmgate price in many markets.
new_findings.calculator_use: Retail-market context and a warning against using retail observations as farmgate revenue. Not a producer-price input.

new_findings.topic: Conflicting official APES crop totals in Annual Economic Report 2026
new_findings.source: Malawi Ministry of Finance, Annual Economic Report 2026, Chapter 3, Tables 3.1-3.3 and narrative
facts: The report's Table 3.1 lists 2024/25 groundnuts at 328,163 MT and 2023/24 at 277,591 MT (+18.2%).
The immediately preceding narrative instead says groundnuts fell 40.7%, from 468,045 MT to 277,591 MT.
Table 3.1 lists 2024/25 beans at 197,086 MT and 2023/24 at 194,175 MT (+1.5%), while narrative says beans fell 17.4%, from 235,089 MT to 194,175 MT.
Table 3.1 lists 2024/25 cowpeas at 60,659 MT and 2023/24 at 44,897 MT (+35.1%), while narrative says cowpeas fell 20.8%, from 56,691 MT to 44,897 MT.
Maize table and narrative agree on 2,859,948 MT for 2024/25 and 2,712,578 MT for 2023/24; ADD-level maize production table is available.
new_findings.calculator_use: Preserve both published versions and request Ministry/APES clarification. Do not silently select or overwrite groundnut, bean or cowpea totals. Production totals alone are not yield without matched harvested area.

readiness_assessment.evidence_improvement: IHS6 now provides a credible route to actual plot-level production, area, input expenditure, labour, sales and livestock microdata; NACA 2025 adds small-area geography and structural coverage. This materially improves the path to a locally grounded profile.
blockers: Download and inspect IHS6 agriculture microdata and documentation; determine variables, weights, crop definitions, season-specific reference periods, and usable sample sizes at region/district levels.
Extract NACA 2025 crop/land/irrigation/machinery/labour tables and microdata access details.
Resolve APES 2024/25 narrative-versus-table discrepancies for groundnuts, beans and cowpeas with the Ministry or source tables.
Obtain current, dated farmer-paid prices for seed, fertilizer, crop protection, hired labour, machinery, irrigation, energy, transport and livestock feed/veterinary inputs.
Obtain current realized producer prices by crop and region; do not substitute minimum-price policy or retail prices.
Construct weighted regional enterprise budgets and commodity-to-calculator mappings, then test the existing 17 profiles and locale routes.
readiness_assessment.next_step: Retrieve IHS6 data and codebook from the World Bank Microdata Library; inspect NACA 2025 report tables; reconcile APES table/narrative conflicts before any Malawi calculator activation.
